## Functions

### `createActorGroundNavigation({ actorId, bodyId, body, readWorld, resolveAnchor, assertCurrent, assertAuthorized, arrivalRadius = 0.15, maxIterations = 8192 } = {})`

Host-owned ground-navigation adapter. The supplied grid must already encode this body's clearance and access constraints. Its body resolves every move against real collision geometry; pathfinding alone is not collision proof. No body, clock, timer or authority is allocated here.
